name: Mother
overview: Scripture commands honoring and respecting mothers as a fundamental duty, promising longevity and blessing for those who do so, as seen in Exodus 20:12. The serious consequences for dishonoring or cursing one's mother, including death, emphasize the sacredness of this relationship (Exodus 21:15, 21:17; Leviticus 20:9). Additionally, the law protects the dignity of mothers, forbidding uncovering their nakedness (Leviticus 18:7) and instructing fear and reverence toward them (Leviticus 19:3). These passages collectively affirm the high value God places on motherhood and the respect due to mothers within the covenant community.
